missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Будущее' is a neuter substantivized adjective in the nominative as the subject. 'Непредсказуемо' is the neuter predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Будущее' is the neuter accusative, identical to the nominative. It is the object of 'строим', and 'светлое' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Будущего' is the neuter genitive form after 'боюсь', which governs the genitive. The adjectival ending takes the genitive too.

missions.phrase: Он смотрит в будущее с надеждой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Будущее' is the neuter accusative after 'в', showing where his gaze is directed. 'С надеждой' adds the instrumental of manner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Будущим' is the neuter instrumental form after 'связана с'. The adjectival noun takes the instrumental ending.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В будущем' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mean in the future. A very common time expression.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О будущем' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Детей' is the genitive, naming whose future.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Будущего' is the neuter genitive showing what the profession belongs to. It modifies 'профессия'.
Strategic focus: Genitive in negation. 'Будущего' is the neuter genitive required after 'нет'. 'Хорошего' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Будущее' is the neuter accusative object of 'видишь'. 'Своё' agrees in the neuter, and 'каким' uses the instrumental of the predicate.
